name: Swiss Institute
notes:
SI purchased 250 Bowery outright (first owned premises in its 40-year history) and the building is closed for construction, reopening spring 2027 with a group show, "The Environment." Current programming is entirely offsite/international (e.g. "Regift" featuring Sylvie Fleury at Luma Westbau, Zurich, Jun 13–Sep 6, 2026) — not NYC-based, so excluded from manual.ts. Revisit when the Bowery space reopens.
